-- CP11 schema change demo, step 2b: the UNGUARDED pipeline (the "before" picture).
-- select * in L1, no casts, no contract, not watched by the guard alert.
-- Same L0, same numbers at baseline, so the two pipelines can be compared side by side.

create schema if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE comment = 'Unguarded pipeline: select *, no contract, no guard';

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.L1_EQUIPMENT as
select * from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.EQUIPMENT;

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION as
select * from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.MAINT_NOTIFICATION;

create or replace dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.DT_DOWNTIME
  target_lag = '1 minute' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Unguarded L2: notification detail, select * from L1'
as select n.*, e.EQUIPMENTNAME, e.PLANT, e.FLEETTYPE
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION n
   join {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.L1_EQUIPMENT e on e.EQUIPMENT = n.EQUIPMENT;

create or replace dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.DT_SITE_SUMMARY
  target_lag = '1 minute' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Unguarded L2 tier 2: downtime by site and month'
as select case PLANT when '1710' then 'Mine A' when '1010' then 'Mine B' else 'Other' end as SITE,
          date_trunc('month', CREATEDON) as MONTH,
          count(*) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(DOWNTIMEHOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.DT_DOWNTIME
   group by all;

select count(*) || ' rows in unguarded DT_DOWNTIME' from {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.DT_DOWNTIME;
